title: Tracing How Language Models Integrate Temporal Anchors into Factual Recall
abstract: arXiv:2611.01945v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Factual recall in language models is typically framed as retrieving a factual association: a subject--relation pair maps to a single object. However, many facts are context-dependent: the same pair maps to different objects depending on a condition such as time. We introduce anchored factual recall, in which the model receives an explicit conditioning expression, an anchor, and must select the object valid under it. This raises questions that single-object recall does not: where the anchor enters the computation, what it changes, and how that change selects the answer. Focusing on temporal anchors, we answer them with causal interventions on four open-weight models on English prompts and identify two routes. In a subject-mediated route, the anchor resolves the final subject-token representation to the queried year, and the relation redistributes the readout of this state across attention heads. translated_title: 追踪语言模型如何将时间锚点整合到事实回忆中
translated_abstract: 语言模型中的事实回忆通常被框定为检索一种事实关联：一个主语—关系对映射到单一宾语。然而，许多事实是依赖于上下文的：同一主语—关系对会根据时间等条件映射到不同的宾语。我们提出了锚定事实回忆这一任务，其中模型接收一个显式的条件表达式（即锚点），并且必须选择在该锚点下有效的宾语。这引发了单一对象回忆所不会涉及的问题：锚点在何处进入计算过程，它改变了什么，以及这种改变如何选择出答案。我们聚焦于时间锚点，通过对四个开源权重模型在英文提示上进行因果干预来回答这些问题，并识别出两条路径。在主语介导路径中，锚点将最终的主语词元表示解析为所查询的年份，而关系则将该状态的读出重新分配到各个注意力头中。在直接路径中，最终位置的注意力……
tldr: 该论文提出“锚定事实回忆”新任务，通过对四个开源模型进行因果干预，揭示了语言模型整合时间锚点的两条机制路径——锚点先解析主语词元表示为查询年份再由关系重新分配读出的主语介导路径，以及最终位置注意力直接参与选择的直接路径。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "anchored factual recall" and uses causal interventions on four open-weight models to reveal two mechanistic routes by which language models integrate temporal anchors: a subject-mediated route where the anchor resolves the subject-token representation to the queried year before the relation redistributes its readout, and a direct route involving final-position attention.
